name: hypergsd
description: Get Stuff Done in hypermedia: the HyperGSD plugin family for TiddlyWiki

scripts.build:site: rm -rf editions/site/plugins && cp -r plugins editions/site/plugins && tiddlywiki ./editions/site --output ./output --build single-file
scripts.serve: rm -rf editions/site/plugins && cp -r plugins editions/site/plugins && tiddlywiki ./editions/site --listen
